Question: What does the &quot;yield&quot; keyword do in Python?

The yield keyword turns a function into a generator. Author: another user explained iterators.
Python generators produce values lazily and keep local state between next() calls.
This answer walks through a simple countdown generator and the difference from return.
Comments discuss generator expressions, send(), and yield from.
The accepted solution shows a producer-consumer pattern using yield.
Later answers cover asyncio and async generators.
